title: rr-dash: Time Travel on a Stream

chapters.title: A Trace Is Not Yet a Tool
chapters.blurb: An rr trace holds a whole execution — and on disk it is a folder you can do nothing with. The upload turns it into addressable streams.

chapters.title: The Shape of a Recording
chapters.blurb: Append-only index, latest-per-id fold, tombstones, chunked linetrace — the whole storage engine in a handful of streams.

chapters.title: Watching Extraction Live
chapters.blurb: The extractor narrates its own progress: NDJSON deltas tailed onto a live stream, pumped every 1.5 seconds into a growing fold.

chapters.title: The DevTools Face
chapters.blurb: Gutter hit counts, execution-point popovers with copyable rr replay commands, the events console, and the flame drawer.
